name: Cricket Chase VR
summary:
Take guard in Cricket Chase, a single-player VR cricket batting game for Meta Quest. Read the bounce, swing your controller like a cricket bat and pick your gap. Keep the scoreboard moving with grounded shots or go over the boundary for six.

T20 • Chase runs in 20 overs. Make the most of the powerplay before the field spreads out.
ODI • Chase runs in 50 overs. Build your innings, find the gaps, and decide when to take on the boundary fielders.
Single Practice • Face unlimited deliveries at your own pace. K
